$comment: Edits to CFBD's /teams aliases, keyed by CFBD team id (issue #417). An entry is a list (aliases to add) or an object with 'add' and/or 'remove' lists. Ingest (cfb_strength/ingest/team_alias_overrides.py) drops the removals from CFBD's alternateNames, then appends the additions, all compared case-insensitively, when it fills teams.alternate_names. A removal CFBD's record no longer carries is an ingest error. An entry needs evidence: a common fan form CFBD doesn't carry (or gives to the wrong school), and a lookup sweep showing it moves no query that resolves today. 57 Florida, add 'UF': 'UF' is the Gators' everyday name, but CFBD gives Florida only ['FLA','Florida'], so 'UF' asked ?Buffalo|UCF in every golden year. 2224 Findlay, remove 'UF': CFBD gives Findlay (D-II, in our teams table 2021-2025) ['UF','Findlay']; 'UF' belongs to Florida, and while Findlay keeps it the sport-wide 'Your team' alias lookup (apps/api resolve_user_team) sees two owners and resolves nobody. Findlay keeps 'Findlay'.
